subject: A District Officer's desk in his bungalow office, early on a cold-weather morning. Polished teak with a visible grain. A dark green leather blotter with gilt tooling and leather corner straps lies in the middle of the frame and its surface is completely bare. To the left a brass inkwell and a pen rest; to the right a small brass handbell, a glass tumbler, and a low wooden rack holding rubber stamps with turned wooden handles. A wire in-tray at the far corner. A brass oil lamp at the back left throws a warm pool across the wood. Behind, a shuttered window with cold pale light and a glimpse of the verandah.
